evidence.decision: Separates copy transfer, ongoing permissioned access and synchronous SharePlay, then binds the choice to backend capability and a small access model.
evidence.artifact: Requires a copy-versus-access artifact with participant management, permissions and object-specific universal-link destinations.
evidence.transformation: Silent anyone-can-edit sharing becomes explicit copy/collaborate choice and persistent document-bound management rather than a generic Share action.
evidence.verification: Verifies recipient scope, revocation, copy representation and update destinations; broader access than described or missing management fails.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies tvOS unavailability, Watch ShareLink and visionOS Full Space streaming pause; does not equate a mocked share sheet with backend enforcement.
evidence.handoffs: Activity views handles share mechanics while Privacy handles exposure; neither handoff replaces the permission model.
evidence.distinctiveness: Copy representation, participant management and update-link ownership make this an operational collaboration procedure.
